style: Simplified, chunky stylized fantasy game art with about 30 percent less detail than a typical painted fantasy asset: a few big readable shapes, thick dark-brown outlines, flat color masses with two-step cel shading and one soft highlight, very little texture. No filigree, no tiny rivets, no engraved patterns, no gem encrustations, no pedestals, stands or display bases, no ornate frames. Light deformation is welcome (exaggerate the one key part, simplify the rest); cute but not childish. Saturated but harmonious colors. Do not imitate any existing game, character, franchise or official artwork. Include no text, letters, numerals, logos or symbols. These icons belong to the half-dragon warrior heroine and may use her motifs: copper-red dragon scales, black-iron dragon claws with ember-orange cracks, crimson dragon blood and ember fire. Palette: blackened iron #2A2426, copper-red #B5532E, crimson #8E1B23, ivory #EFE2C4, ember #FF8A2A.
